title: Workbench
summary: The workbench in its own workbench. Dark monochrome chrome, hairline structure and independent collection palettes.

direction.product: Shows an app's real tokens, components and screens in one place, without owning any of them.
direction.world: A specimen drawer in a dark room: hairline labels, monospace captions, and each collection's colors lit on their own.
moments: The color signature band at the top of a collection
Fixture previews, which belong to the app and keep its appearance
direction.signature: The color signature: every color token as one band, read with the pointer or the arrow keys.
voice: Say what a view proves and what it does not.
